message.content:
**神舟八号（Shenzhou‑8）** 是中国首次进行自动对接试验的无人飞行任务，于 2008 年 9 月 25 日发射。该任务没有乘员，属于“无人试验”阶段。  

> **乘员名单**：无（无人飞行）  

如果你想了解有人类乘员的首次载人飞行，那是 **神舟九号（Shenzhou‑9）**，其乘员为杨利伟和刘伯明。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew of Shenzhou 8. Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight mission in 2008. It was an unmanned test flight? Actually Shenzhou 8 was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft with a robotic arm, but it was unmanned. Wait: Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 25 September 2008. It was the first test of the docking system. It had no crew. So answer: It was unmanned, no astronauts. But maybe the user expects the names of the crew? The correct answer: No crew; it was an unmanned test flight. Provide explanation.
